# Tantrāloka: where the secondary literature cites each verse

Rebuilt on 6 Oct 2026 from the PDFs in `Library` as they now stand, including the OCR text layers added on 5–6 Oct 2026. Every reference such as "TĀ 3.67", "T.A. 3/67", "TA XIII, 279", "TĀV 3.67" (Jayaratha's commentary on that verse) or "Tantrāloka 3.67" in a PDF's text was matched to a verse note; ranges such as "3.67–70" are listed under their first verse. Translations and editions of the Tantrāloka itself (Dyczkowski's translation and drafts, the Singh and Maheshvarananda volume) are left out. Each verse below lists the works that cite it, linked to the PDF page. Because the verse is linked here, the same list shows in the backlinks panel of each verse note.

**Limits.** No PDF searched lacks a text layer altogether, but six of the 605 have text on fewer than half their pages (under 50 characters on the rest), so their citations are incomplete until they are OCR'd; the one in `Library/Trika` is Rastogi's *The Metaphysics and Tantric Esotericism of Krama*, Part 3. OCR spelling noise can hide a reference ("Tantriiloka", "1O" for 10, digits split by spaces); split digits were joined only when the result is a real verse, and a run such as "20.1 15" was read as a range whose dash was lost only when that is the one reading that gives real verses. References written another way ("verse 67 of the third chapter", "ibid.", a verse number given without its chapter) are missed. Chapter numbers in Roman numerals ("TĀ XIII 279", "T.A. XV, 295") are matched; citations of Jayaratha's commentary by volume and page ("TĀV vol. 2, p. 56", "TAV 9(15)160") are not verse references and are left out. Page numbers are printed page numbers (since 26 Oct 2026), taken from the page markers of the vault's Markdown copy of each book; where a page prints no number, or a book has no Markdown copy, the PDF page is given as "PDF n". Every link still opens the page in the PDF or in the Markdown copy.
